uncertainties: The drawing is a single silhouette; the object is assumed to be rotationally symmetric (a vase) rather than a flat cutout or irregular shape.
Wall thickness is not specified; the model is generated as a solid (watertight) for 3D printing.
interpretation_conflicts: OpenCV detected two contours (outer and inner), but the visual evidence is a single line drawing. The inner contour is interpreted as a stroke artifact or thickness, not a separate hole.
generation_notes: The silhouette is regularized to smooth out hand-drawn jitter. The profile is closed at the bottom to ensure watertightness. The top is left open to represent the vase opening.
